 14 Best Deals In Singapore This Week – 16th-22nd November 2026 
 Khoo Yong Hao 
 • 
 16 Nov 2026 
 • 
 Sales & Promotions 
 • 
 11 minutes reading time 
 Best deals in Singapore this week 
 If there’s one essential life skill Singaporeans are equipped with by default, it’s the coveted ability to scour far and wide for the best deals and promos in Singapore . After all, saving a few bucks here and there never hurt anyone, and your bank balance will thank you in the long run. From home essentials to foodie treats, here are some of the best ones we’ve sussed out this week.
 Table of Contents
 Best deals in Singapore this week 1. Amazon Singapore Black Friday Sale 
 2. Nitori Furniture Outlet Sale 
 3. Yee3 ION Orchard outlet opening promotion 
 4. Surrey Hills Grocer Christmas promotion 
 5. Singapore Airlines 11.11 Deals 
 6. Matchaya new Kakigori flavours 
 7. Teo Heng Family KTV Studio weekday promotion 
 8. Commune by Metropolitan YMCA new buffets promo 
 9. The Soup Expert 1st Anniversary promotion 
 10. Shin Katsu 1-for-1 katsu sets 
 11. SAFRA members 1-for-1 Universal Studios Singapore tickets 
 12. Bochinche Weekend Free-Flow Steak Lunch Buffet 
 13. DBS PayLah! cashback campaign 
 14. Marriott Bonvoy Never-Ending Staycation 
 1. Amazon Singapore Black Friday Sale 
 Up to 35% off name brands & daily flash vouchers for more savings 
Image credit: Amazon 
 Though 11.11 might have left a sizable dent in your wallet, the sales are still going strong; just take a look at Amazon Singapore ’s Black Friday Sale . Running for 12 days, you’ll be able to snag deals across a wide range of categories, from children’s toys to skincare products. Here are some of the discounts to tempt you to cart out:
 Up to 35% off Bioderma
 Up to 30% off TEMPUR
 Up to 30% off Crayola & Hot Wheels
 Up to 25% off ASUS
 Up to 20% off Salomon
 Up to 20% off LANEIGE
 Up to 20% off Samsung
 Up to 20% off Pampers & Huggies
 What’s more, keep your eyes peeled for daily flash deals that’ll drop at 12am, 12pm, and 6pm throughout the sale. It’s also a great time to pick up an Amazon Prime membership too, if you’re planning on going on a massive shopping spree. You’ll get free shipping on millions of eligible items, extra discounts, and access to exclusive Prime-only TV shows and movies.
 Shop the Amazon Singapore Black Friday Sale .
 2. Nitori Furniture Outlet Sale 
 Up to 70% off furniture at Bugis Junction outlet 
 Image credit: TTT via Google Maps 
 IKEA’s not the only place where you can get steals on furniture to deck out your abode. Check out Nitori Bugis Junction ’s Furniture Outlet Sale that’s happening from now till 22nd November 2026 . The savings here aren’t anything to scoff at – it features savings of up to a whopping 70% .
 Some home finds to look forward to include heavy discounts on electric recliners, dining tables and chairs, and office chairs, just to name a few.
 Promo period: Now till 22nd November 2026
 3. Yee3 ION Orchard outlet opening promotion 
 1-for-1 drinks & 20% off entire drink menu 
Image credit: Yee3 
 Yee3 is another establishment hailing from China is coming after CHAGEE’s customers, as their very first outlet on the Little Red Dot is set to open later this week within ION Orchard.
 View this post on Instagram 
 To celebrate new beginnings, they’re inviting you to swing by to taste-test their famous coconut beverages with a sweet 20% discount on all drinks from 16th to 19th November 2026 . You’ll also receive an adorable Yee3 Penguin Sponge with the purchase of any 2 drinks.
 During their grand opening, from 20th to 22nd November 2026 , they’re one-upping their previous promotion by handing out 1-for-1 drinks , applicable to their entire menu except the Coconut Frost Shake series.
 Promo period: Now till 22nd November 2026
 4. Surrey Hills Grocer Christmas promotion 
 New festive sets & bundles with up to 15% off takeaway pre-orders 
 The festive season ain’t all about gift-giving; it’s also a time for plentiful feasts, and Surrey Hills Grocer is giving you the go-ahead to begin digging in before we even hit December. They’ve just launched a new Christmas set and bundle, perfect eating out or bringing the celebrations home.
 Image adapted from: Surrey Hills Grocer 
 Their Festive Set for Two (from $88) is available for dine-in only, and features a sumptuous serving of Christmas Porchetta, Tender Seared Turkey, and for dessert, Just Like Dubai Log Cake. On the other hand, dabao the Christmas Feast Bundle ($399) that feeds 5 to 8 pax; it’s packed with a generous spread that sports the same 2 meats and log cake, along with their Slow-Roasted Premium Angus Beef Striploin.
 Surrey Hills Grocer will also be running a promotion on Christmas takeaway pre-orders; enjoy 15% off your orders from now till 18th November , or 10% off from 19th to 30th November 2026 .
 Promo period: Now till 30th November 2026
 5. Singapore Airlines 11.11 Deals 
 Affordable flights to destinations like Perth, Da Nang, Madrid & KL 
Image credit: Singapore Airlines 
 We know we’ve just landed into the holidays, but for the forward-looking few who’re already scheming to put together a getaway when 2027 hits, Singapore Airlines has got you covered. Their 1 1.11 Deals are still ongoing, and you’ve got till 20th November 2026 to secure your flights, at discounted rates of course.
 Here are some of the hottest destinations that you can gun for:
 Destination 
 Price 
 Da Nang, Vietnam 
 From $306 
 Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam 
 From $269

 From $211

 From $267

 Do note that the outbound travel period for tickets purchased during the sale ranges from 1st January to 31st May 2027 , so you unfortunately can’t sneak in any last-minute trips this year.
 Promo period: Now till 20th November 2026
 6. Matchaya new Kakigori flavours 
 30% off 5 new shaved ice dessert flavours at Tiong Bahru outlet 
 We’re well on our way to the monsoon season, but if the rain hasn’t dampened your cravings for icy cold desserts, Matchaya ’s the place to be. They’ve just launched new kakigori flavours , and you’ll be able to indulge in all 5 of them at a 30% discount all day long, exclusively at their Tiong Bahru outlet .
Image credit: Matchaya 
 Tea lovers, go for their Signature Koicha Azuki ($22) ; it’s made using 2 single-origin ceremonial matcha flavours for that distinct, earthy kick, complemented by Azuki beans and delicate Hokkaido milk cream espuma. But if you want a sweeter treat to reward yourself with, their Strawberry Yogurt ($20) creation will hit the spot, while those with a penchant for chocolate can opt for the Chocolate Tiramisu ($18) for 2 dessert classics blended into 1.
 Promo period: Now till 22nd November 2026
 7. Teo Heng Family KTV Studio weekday promotion 
 $10/hour karaoke rooms from Mon to Thu at 5 locations 
Image credit: The Centrepoint 
 When you’ve got some steam to let off in the middle of the week, jio your friends for karaoke night at Teo Heng Family KTV Studio . They’re having a weekday promotion valid from Mondays to Thursdays which allows customers to croon their hearts out from just $10/hour (U.P. $13/hour) , per room.
 You heard right; book their Small Room and bring 3 other friends, and you’ll be paying a mere $2.50 each for your session. When your voice is getting raspy, they’ve got $1 drinks available too. This promotion is only valid at the following outlets: Hougang CC , Punggol Coast Mall, Oasis Terrace , Bukit Timah CC , and Changi Airport .
 Promo period: Now till 31st January 2027
 8. Commune by Metropolitan YMCA new buffets promo 
 1-for-1 deal on new lunch & dinner buffets 
 Image credit: Commune by Metropolitan YMCA 
 For those with a ravenous appetite, bring a buddy for Commune by Metropolitan YMCA ’s new buffets. They’ve got a tasty 1-for-1 promotion on their refreshed lunch and dinner buffets , each featuring their own spread of delectable bites.
 Image credit: Commune by Metropolitan YMCA 
 Swing by from 12pm to 2pm for their lunch buffet (from $48) to feast on a yummy selection of local faves such as curry fish head, claypot chicken rice, and rojak. Meanwhile, the dinner buffet (from $72) takes its place from 6pm to 9pm , and promises unlimited meats and sides, which include the likes of steaks, duck leg confit, and truffle mac and cheese to close out your night.
 Promo period: Now till 31st December 2026
 9. The Soup Expert 1st Anniversary promotion 
 Enjoy $1 soups with a minimum spend of $29.90 
 Image credit: Eatbook 
 As we inch closer to the end of the year, the monsoon season’s fast approaching, which means there’ll be more rainy days to come. If you’re ever caught in the storm, duck into Suntec City and warm up with a nourishing brew at The Soup Expert . They are celebrating their 1st anniversary , and you’ll be able to enjoy their delectable soups for just a dollar.
 Yes, you heard right; simply rack up a minimum spend of $29.90 , and you can enjoy 1 selected soup for just $1 . Diners who spend at least $59.80 get to slurp on 2 selected soups at $1 each .
 Promo period: Now till 31st December 2026
 10. Shin Katsu 1-for-1 katsu sets 
 1-for-1 deal on new Hirata Rosu Katsu Sets every Monday 
 Image adapted from: Shin Katsu 
 You don’t have to hop on a plane to Japan to savour the deep-fried delicacy that is tonkatsu, because Shin Katsu ’s crunchy offerings are as authentic as it gets. In fact, they’re the only tonkatsu restaurant on the island that serves up premium Hirata Farm pork , which is renowned for its rich marbling and exceptional tenderness.
 If you’re already watering at the mouth, now’s the time to head over. The restaurant has a 1-for-1 deal on their new Hirata Rosu Katsu sets ($36.80 ) available every Monday throughout the months of November and December . Masterfully prepared, the set features a light, crispy panko coating, which captures and complements the pork’s natural juiciness.
 Promo period: 1st November-31st December 2026
 11. SAFRA members 1-for-1 Universal Studios Singapore tickets 
 Member-exclusive 1-for-1 adult USS tickets & discounted child admission 
 We’re giving you the go-ahead to hound your friends and relatives who happen to be SAFRA members . That’s because they’ve got a member-exclusive, 1-for-1 deal for adult Universal Studios Singapore tickets . You heard right; to honour 59 years of National Service, SAFRA’s egging you on to bring your family out for a day of fun at USS with this attractive promo.
 The little ones can also come along for the ride, as they can enjoy $10 off admission tickets as well ($59, U.P. $69) . The promo runs till the end of the year, so an outing is definitely in the books once school’s out.
 Book 1-for-1 tickets to Universal Studios Singapore .
 Promo period: Now till 31st December 2026
 12. Bochinche Weekend Free-Flow Steak Lunch Buffet 
 Free-flow steaks from $55/pax & attractive weekday deals 
 Image credit: Bochinche 
 Meat lovers should be no strangers to Bochinche , an Argentine steakhouse and bar over on Club Street. In case you’re not in the know, they’ve got a 90-minute Weekend Free-Flow Steak Lunch Buffet available on Saturdays, Sundays, and Public Holidays, which is just music to the ears of anyone trying to hit their daily protein intake.
Image credit: Bochinche 
 For just $55/pax , you’ll get to feast on unlimited servings of signature Argentinian steaks straight off the grill. But if that’s not enough to satisfy your meaty cravings, the Argentine Butcher’s Board (from $236) is perfect for an indulgent feast; it features a 1.4kg platter of Ribeye , Tenderloin , Sirloin , Rump Cap , and House Chorizo , surely enough to go around.
 Should weekend visits elude you, the restaurant also has deals from Mondays through Thursdays , making weekday meals here mighty attractive:
 Mondays 6pm-9pm: 1-for-1 200g steaks (Argentina Ribeye/Sirloin)
 Tuesdays: Complimentary all-day corkage
 Wednesdays 6pm-9pm: Discounted Argentinian Butcher’s Board from $185
 Thursdays 6pm-8pm: 50% off signature cocktails
 Promo period: Now till further notice
 13. DBS PayLah! cashback campaign 
 Up to $3 cashback at participating heartland merchants & hawkers 
 Good news for folks looking to save on their coffeeshop runs during the weekends, as DBS is bringing back their PayLah! cashback campaign .
 On Saturdays only from now till 19th December 2026 , you can enjoy up to $3 in cashback whenever you use their app to pay for your purchases at participating heartland shops, wet markets, coffeeshops and hawkers islandwide. Do note that the $3 cashback is limited to the first 160,000 redemptions islandwide, starting at 6am .
 Learn more about DBS’ PayLah! cashback campaign .
 Promo period: Now till 19th December 2026
 14. Marriott Bonvoy Never-Ending Staycation 
 Promo code for free daily breakfast for 2 & dinner at specialty restaurant 
 The Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel.
 Image credit: Marriott  
 There’s no shame in booking a staycay right here in sunny Singapore to stave off the corporate burnout, and Marriott Bonvoy concurs. As part of their latest Never-Ending Staycation promotion, simply key in the code <HOL> when booking your stays at any one of their 19 hotels on the Little Red Dot to enjoy the following:
 Free daily breakfasts for 2
 1 dinner for 2 with at least 3 courses & a drink each at a speciality or all-day dining  restaurant
 Up to 2 kids under 12 years of age dine for free with a paying adult
 Book a stay at a Marriott Bonvoy hotel .
 Promo period: Now till 23rd December 2026
 Make the most of this week’s best deals in Singapore 
 With massive discounts and offers ranging from tech and travel to lifestyle and F&B, there’s something for everyone in this week’s roundup of top deals in Singapore. Just be sure to act fast, as many of these promos are only valid for a short time, and once they’re gone, they’re gone. Happy bargain hunting!
